environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string parameters against pattern `(?i)(?:union[\s/\*]+select|select[\s/\*]+.*from|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*;\s*--|%27|\x27)` with action BLOCK and label 'awswaf:managed:custom:sqli-qs', (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking, used for metrics). The custom rule at priority 200 inspects SingleQueryArgument on all query parameters using TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE. CloudWatch alarm triggers on label matches but the BLOCK action is immediate at the WAF edge. The ALB target group health check hits /health endpoint.
